brief:
Pennsylvania Senator John Fetterman has threatened to leave the Democratic Party if the next Senate leader is critical of Israel, according to Middle East Eye. His remarks targeted Senator Van Hollen, who has accused Israel of using food as a weapon of war in Gaza.

The dispute reflects deepening divisions within the Democratic caucus over how to approach Israel's military operations and humanitarian policies in the Palestinian territory.

title: Fetterman threatens to leave Democrats over Israel-critical Senate leader
